svg.text: 34 FACP mains, battery, earth, loop fault
F20-2 Cause-and-effect matrix of building B2 (example, rev 6): 34 causes against 14 effects

X = effect required · 30 s / 10 s = agent countdown · hold = countdown held while the abort switch is pressed · owner = effect set by the owner decision in the BOD · sol. = pre-action solenoid released, water only after air loss
• Every X is tested with an observer at the effect, and every blank in the same row is checked for no action (20.9.6).
• O8 (agent release) appears only on rows 13, 14 and 20: the end of the countdown after two detectors, the manual release station and the battery room coincidence.
